question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

It is better to end up certain matters than ______ a dead horse.
solution:
The correct answer is **"beating."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase** "beating a dead horse" **means to continue to pursue a particular point or topic even though it is no longer productive or relevant. (किसी विशेष बिंदु या विषय पर आगे बढ़ना जारी रखना, भले ही वह अब उत्पादक या प्रासंगिक न रह गया हो)

 
 
• **Example**: *He keeps trying to get it published, but I think he's **beating a dead horse**__.*
 
 
 
• The phrase is often used in reference to discussions or arguments that have already been resolved or to efforts that are no longer worthwhile.
 
• In this context, the sentence is suggesting that it is better to bring certain matters to a close rather than continuing to focus on them even when they are no longer useful.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

**Correct sentence**: *It is better to end up certain matters than __**beating**__ a dead horse.*
